text:
lee: opening a controlled apply for tenant-99 infra (network + iam + natgw). canary target: eu-west-1c only, 10m quiet window. provider pinned to v4.3.0+sha256:ff11aa. no provider bumps during window. pls ack if you have live deploys.

deploybot: plan started -> https://deploy.logs/infra/tenant-99/plan/6180012345 :mag: 

deploybot: plan summary: 5 changes, 1 replace (aws_nat_gateway), 1 new resource (aws_route53_record). potential risk: route53 record TTL change and IAM policy tightening.

tori: ack. I'll review IAM delta, watching for wildcard grants.

sam: we have a db migration targeting the same tenant at +30m, I'll gate my migration until you signal.

lee: good catch sam. we'll finish tenant-99 rollout before your migration. added a preflight that verifies tfstate backup exists: ```bash
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-tfstate-backups/tenant-99/6180012345.snapshot || exit 2
```

sec-bot: compliance scan scheduled: iam-policy-lint on changed policies. webhook -> this thread.

opsbot: created canary monitor tenant-99-eu (latency p50, dns error rate). alerts to #incidents and thread.

deploybot: preflight apply command: ```bash
TF_WORKSPACE=tenant-99 TF_VAR_env=prod \
terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.network -var-file=tenant-99.prod.tfvars
```

lee: starting canary apply in eu-west-1c now.

deploybot: canary apply started 6180012360. plan attached.

deploybot: canary apply complete 6180012380 963: no errors. nat gateway replaced (attached EIP swapped).

lee: smoke checks: BGP routes present, DNS record correct, NAT gw healthy.

tori: iam lint result: flagged one policy with overly broad sts:AssumeRole on service-account. pushing small TF tweak to narrow it; recommend hold before full rollout.

lee: hold full rollout. pausing waves. sam: your migration stay paused.

sam: ack. pausing now.

lee: we will patch the iam policy and re-run plan. manual approval required after patch.

sec-bot: flagged change requires security review; escalation to sec-oncall if not approved in 20m.

lee: patched and pushed commit. running plan again.
deploybot: plan re-run complete 963: shows 1 policy change (narrowed assumeRole).

tori: lgtm from IAM side.

lee: re-run canary apply in eu-west-1c.
deploybot: canary apply 2 started 6180012395. finished 6180012405 963: success.

opsbot: metrics stable: p50 steady, dns error rate <0.1%.

lee: proceeding with full region rollout in two waves: eu-west-1a then eu-west-1b, 12m stagger. note rollback plan: use tfstate rollback snapshot command documented in runbook and remove the replaced natgw if connectivity regressions > 15% or dns failures > 0.5% for 3m. runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/infra/tenant-99/rollback

sam: thanks. will resume migration after final wave and green checks.

lee: adding release note: "tenant-99: replace NAT gateway, tighten IAM assumeRole for service accounts, add route53 record TTL update (canary eu-west-1c)". tagging release manager. :memo:

tori: will attach plan diffs to the release ticket when waves finish.

lee: keeping thread open for 45m post-rollout. reach out on thread for immediate approvals.
